EmailTemplate.subject: Performance International User Request Sent to Data Privacy
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for letting me know that you are looking to have International Employees utilize the Insperity Premier Performance Management system. At this point, I have sent a request to our Data Privacy team to confirm that we can grant your International Employees access to the system. I will get back to you shortly with the next steps that your International Employees might need to complete.
Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.
Thank you,
